name: complete
description: Assert all planned work is done. Call with a short summary once every plan step is done or skipped, then write the final response text. While a session plan is active the turn does not end without this call: ending without it reopens the turn once instead of landing. The runtime verifies the assertion against the session plan: if steps are still pending/running/failed, the turn reopens instead of ending. Without an active plan this is a no-op receipt.

summary.description: What was accomplished (one or two sentences).
